findings.description: The background banner shows the modern Turkish Republic national flag instead of historical Ottoman standards (1453 era).
findings.fix: Replace flag asset with period-accurate 15th-century Ottoman heraldry or solid field banners.
findings.refined_description: A modern red Turkish national flag featuring the white crescent and star is visible on a flagpole in the background on the left.

findings.description: Background crew loading animations show slight robotic gliding and sliding on the ground plane.
findings.fix: Apply foot-locking and natural weight transfer passes to the background extras.

findings.description: Cannon blast produces instantaneous volumetric fireball without mechanical recoil from the wooden carriage.
findings.fix: Add carriage kickback animation and frame-accurate light spill onto foreground subject.
findings.refined_description: When the cannon fires with a massive fireball, the cannon barrel and wooden carriage remain completely stationary without any physical recoil.

summary: Character identity and lip sync remain consistently aligned with the master reference throughout the take. Background animation exhibits minor historical flag inaccuracies and stiff extra motion. The climactic firing effect delivers strong visual punch with minor carriage physics drift.
